stories.title: Recruitment Status Schema and Scoring Contract
stories.description: Define canonical schema for clinical trial recruitment status (RECRUITING, COMPLETED, TERMINATED, ACTIVE_NOT_RECRUITING, UNKNOWN) and map each status to a normalized score contribution with explicit defaults for missing/unknown values.

stories.title: Recruitment Status Extraction and Normalization
stories.description: Implement extraction of recruitment status from ClinicalTrials.gov API payloads and normalize to schema values, including handling of nulls, unexpected enums, and legacy status strings.

stories.title: Recruitment Status Scoring Logic
stories.description: Implement deterministic scoring function assigning highest weight to RECRUITING trials, moderate to ACTIVE_NOT_RECRUITING, and lowest to COMPLETED/TERMINATED, with safe fallback for UNKNOWN.

stories.title: Expose Recruitment Status Score via EvaluateCare Facade
stories.description: Integrate recruitment status score into clinical trial evaluation response and expose through evaluate_care_facade with clear field naming and compatibility with existing response models.

stories.title: Recruitment Status Unit and Integration Tests
stories.description: Add unit tests for normalization and scoring edge cases (unknown, malformed, missing) and integration tests validating end-to-end flow from API ingestion through facade output.
